ptf_management.title: PTF Management Tools
ptf_management.description: Tools for monitoring and managing Program Temporary Fixes (PTFs) and PTF groups on IBM i systems

check_ptf_currency.description: Check PTF group currency status for the current system release. Shows which PTF groups are current, outdated, or have updates available.

list_outdated_ptf_groups.description: List only PTF groups that have updates available, showing how many levels behind each group is.

parameters.name: min_levels_behind
parameters.description: Minimum number of levels behind to include in results (1-100)

get_ptf_group_details.description: Get detailed information about a specific PTF group, including all installed levels and their status.

parameters.name: ptf_group_name
parameters.description: PTF group name or prefix (e.g., 'SF99730', 'SF997'), 2-10 characters

list_installed_ptf_groups.description: List all PTF groups currently installed on the system with optional filtering by status and release.

parameters.name: status_filter
parameters.description: Filter by status: 'INSTALLED', 'APPLY AT NEXT IPL', or '*ALL'

summarize_ptf_status.description: Get a high-level summary of PTF currency status including counts of current, outdated, and unavailable groups.

find_critical_ptf_updates.description: Identify PTF groups that are significantly behind (critical updates needed), sorted by severity.

parameters.name: critical_threshold
parameters.description: Number of levels behind to consider critical (1-100, default: 5)

security_vulnerability_assessment.title: Security Vulnerability Assessment
security_vulnerability_assessment.description: Comprehensive tools for identifying security vulnerabilities, assessing user privileges, file permissions, and potential attack vectors

users_with_limited_capabilities.description: Identify which users are configured with limited capabilities

commands_allowed_for_users_with_limited_.description: Identify which commands on the IBM i can be executed by the `users` with limited capabilities

list_users_who_can_see_all_db2_data.description: Identify which users have *ALLOBJ or *SAVSYS special authorities, can see any Db2 for i data

list_db_files_readable_by_any_user.description: List database files that any user can read

list_db_files_writable_by_any_user.description: List files where any user can insert rows

list_db_files_deletable_by_any_user.description: List all files where any user can delete rows

list_db_files_updatable_by_any_user.description: List all files where any user can update rows

list_db_files_exposed_to_trigger_attack.description: List files exposed to a trigger attack where any user can read and alter or manage the file

list_user_profiles_vulnerable_to_imperso.description: Identify user profiles vulnerable to impersonation attack where *PUBLIC authority is not set to *EXCLUDE

list_public_authority_on_attack_vector_c.description: Identify dangerous commands that *PUBLIC users can execute, enabling potential privilege escalation or data exfiltration

list_files_exposed_to_rename_attack.description: Identify database files vulnerable to rename attacks where *PUBLIC has DATA_EXECUTE & DATA_UPDATE on library plus OBJECT_MANAGEMENT & OBJECT_OPERATIONAL on file

list_system_libraries_allowing_table_cre.description: Identify libraries in system or product portion of library list where *PUBLIC can create tables, exposing system to library list attacks

list_adopted_authority_programs_with_pub.description: Identify programs using adopted authority (USRPRF=*OWNER) that are not secured with *PUBLIC *EXCLUDE or *AUTL, enabling privilege escalation attacks

security_audit.title: Security Audit
security_audit.description: Tools for auditing security configurations and maintaining security data

repopulate_special_authority_detail.description: Repopulate the special authority detail in the SYSTOOLS MQT

check_command_audit_settings.description: Check object audit settings for specified IBM i commands in QSYS library to verify if security logging is enabled

parameters.name: command_names
parameters.description: Array of command names to check audit settings for (e.g., ['ADDPFTRG', 'CRTPGM', 'SAVOBJ']). Common attack vector commands include ADDPFTRG, CRTPGM, CRTSRVPGM, SAVOBJ, SAVLIB, CRTDUPOBJ, CPYF

security_remediation.title: Security Remediation
security_remediation.description: Tools for generating and executing security remediation commands

generate_impersonation_lockdown_commands.description: Generate GRTOBJAUT commands to lock down user profiles vulnerable to impersonation by setting *PUBLIC authority to *EXCLUDE. Returns CL commands as strings without executing them

execute_impersonation_lockdown.description: WRITE OPERATION: Execute GRTOBJAUT commands to lock down user profiles vulnerable to impersonation by setting *PUBLIC authority to *EXCLUDE. This modifies system security settings. Use with caution
